Name: Everia's All Natural Linus Updated
Author: bezajel
Description:
[center][color=#d4d4d8][size=5]-- The update no one asked for but everyone needed --[/size][/color][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]I love Everia's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4470]All Natural Linus[/url] mod, but it was missing the newer portraits and overworld sprites from 1.6. I made the necessary edits, and added a config for the choice to replace Linus's winter appearance as well.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Since permissions on the mod were open, I decided to share my update with the world. [/color][i][color=#d4d4d8]You're Welcome.[/color][/i]

[color=#d4d4d8]Content warning: light nudity. I hate that the only nudity tag is 'Sexualised', because this mod is really not.[/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip and move to your Mods folder.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires Content Patcher.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]By default, only Linus's spring to fall appearance is changed. If you want him to change in winter as well, select the option in GMCM, or set to "true" in the config.json.[/color]


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The original mod and artwork are by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/EveriasArt]Everia[/url]. I edited Everia's assets to make the new portraits and sprites added by 1.6.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Kdau's[size=3] [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/]Stardew Scroll Generator[/url] was used for the scrolls in the thumbnail image.[/size][/color]
